frozen_before: Any biological replay-order association; responds to fixed eight-cell real RUN rate diagnostic. This is a separate development sensitivity, not a selected primary estimator.
scope: Test whether stronger regularization trades improved real RUN prediction for conditional-independence bias. Use the unchanged development generator and source cohort.
source_and_support: All frozen v3 clocks, unit IDs, support masks, spline/circular/speed features and convergence settings remain unchanged. Only the coefficient penalty changes from 1 to 100; no favorable animal or period substitution.
claim_boundary: A favorable held-out rate score cannot substitute for unbiased change measurement. Retain failures explicitly; this sensitivity cannot authorize a biological association.
